$comment: Traceability matrix: every bullet of the pdfnative CHANGELOG entry named by `engine` is either exercised THROUGH pdfnative-react (named tests, and baseline samples where a sample can show it) or waived with a reason. tests/regression/engine-surface.test.ts holds every reference to the tree. The matrix describes ONE engine release — the pinned one — and is rewritten, not extended, when the peer pin moves (CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Bumping the engine pin'); the 1.8.0 matrix is in the git history of this file. Item ids and changelog prefixes are shared with pdfnative-mcp's and pdfnative-cli's matrices, so the three wrappers can be compared line by line. Waiver kinds: LIB (an engine API the authoring surface deliberately does not carry — golden rule 7 — or an internal of the engine with no JSX/DocSpec-facing behaviour), TOOLING / DOCS (the engine repository's own build, CI, samples or documentation), tested-upstream (a rule of the engine the renderer only transmits — `transmission` names the suite that proves the transmission), upstream-limit (observable through the renderer but wrong or incomplete in the engine; see `upstreamLimits`).
